_notes.ollama_model: Mossy fills this in with your chat model when it installs the helpers; any model you have pulled works
_notes.embed_model: Ollama embedding model for lore search (Mossy pulls nomic-embed-text during install)
_notes.chroma_path: Where ChromaDB stores its vector index — relative to creative_director.py
_notes.ai_helper_ws: WebSocket address of the AI Helper (port 8769; 8766 belongs to Brain B)
_notes.vml_ws: WebSocket address of VirtualModLab (port 8768 by default)
_notes.koboldcpp_host: KoboldCpp server (default port 5001). Used when Ollama is not running, or when llm_engine is "koboldcpp"
_notes.hub_host: Optional shared lesson hub URL; leave empty to keep it off
